text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan fought bravely,
but proved no match for Oguri Cap.
As expected, Oguri was simply a cut above.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... No good... Just when I thought
I had a chance, Oguri-san pulled even further ahead...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So strong... And what a captivating race.
Was that deliberate? Or pure talent?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Thank you very much.
And... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She was ridiculously strong.
So that's what a true star Umamusume is like.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "No, you did quite well yourself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap-san?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: To think an Umamusume still in the Classic tier could go this far...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Let us meet again next year. In this exact place, at this same time.
I look forward to seeing how much you've grown."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, it's an honor, Oguri-san!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure to grow even more than you.
I'm still—in my growth spurt, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Y-Yeah..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind those cryptic words,
Oguri Cap walked away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please look.
See... these legs...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "I'm trembling so much. Even though they're such a humorous person, I'm just so terrified..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan's legs were trembling.
Just like when she had first feared Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I was getting stronger...
But maybe I still have a long way to go..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to look down anymore!
I'll work even harder next year!!!
choice_data_list: Next year, huh... What should our target race be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Goals for next year...? In that case, I've already made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I want to go to the Spring Tenno Sho! I want to take this experience and throw it all at McQueen! Please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly. Today's race
will surely serve as great nourishment for the next battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Spring). A rematch with
Mejiro McQueen is bound to be a fiercer battle than ever.
